apps.title: Wolf War: Last Survival
apps.summary:
Explore the world of wolves and embark on a brutal journey of survival and battle amid the conflicts of rival packs. Lead your packmates and allies into fierce clashes against powerful enemies. As the tribe’s last orphan—and its final hope, you must strengthen yourself, recruit formidable wolf heroes, and evolve them into powerful allies ready to face the most terrifying foes.

Key Features:

- RPG Combat
Every bite, claw, and strike matters. Gather resources, strengthen your wolf pack, expand your territory, and conquer the wolf lands.

- Recruit & Research
Recruit and unlock different types of wolf heroes for your pack and unleash their full potential. Each wolf hero adds tactical depth to every fight, raising your odds of victory in every battle.

- Hunt & Evolve
Empower your wolf heroes through multiple upgrade and evolution paths to control the battlefield. Grow stronger is the key to surviving high-intensity clashes.

- Alliance & Conquest
Enter a wild world filled with adventure and mystery. Uncover the secrets of the packs, meet wolves of many kinds, and stand together against overwhelming threats. The pack's survival war is full of challenges—and rich rewards.

Join Wolf War: Last Survival, explore the world of the wolf packs, plunge into the wolf war, and become the strongest alpha. The wild shows no mercy. Lead with fangs and fury.

apps.title: QB Clash: Quarterback Football
apps.summary:
QB Clash is an American football passing game played in 1v1 duels. Each duel has three rounds: deep, mid and red zone. You and your opponent throw on the same plays, against the same defense and wind, and the higher score wins.

• Pull back to aim, hold still until the ring tightens, then let go.
• Catches are graded for placement: On target, Dime or Pinpoint. Yards in the air, yards after the catch, contested catches, tight spirals and touchdowns all add to your score.
• See the routes before the snap, read the defense and adjust for wind.
• Win duels to earn trophies and coins, and unlock 10 gridiron stadiums, from Sandlot Park and Campus Bowl to the Championship Dome. Higher stadiums add new plays and defenses.
• Collect and upgrade quarterback and receiver cards to improve arm, accuracy, release, speed and hands.
• Customize your team's city, name, jersey, helmet and logo, and pick your touchdown dances.
• Play in weekly leagues for prizes, and take on the Money Shot challenge on weekends for coins, gems and more.

apps.title: Wordsect - Word Puzzle Games
apps.summary:
Wordsect combines crossword puzzles with connected letter tiles and satisfying tile breaks. Find words on the letter board, fill the crossword grid, and plan which tiles to use next.

The numbers change how you play. Each tile has a limited number of uses, shown on its face. Use a tile to form a word and its count goes down. When the count reaches zero, it cracks and crumbles. A word that fits now may use letters you need later, so look beyond your next answer.

HOW TO PLAY
- Connect neighboring letters up, down, left, or right to form words.
- Find words that fit the crossword grid.
- Check the numbers to track each tile's remaining uses.
- Watch a tile break apart when its count reaches zero.

CROSSWORDS WITH AN EXTRA CHALLENGE
Solving the crossword is only part of the puzzle. Explore letter paths and consider how each word affects the tiles still available. Put vocabulary, spelling, and planning together as you work towards a completed grid.

A SATISFYING WAY TO FIND WORDS
Letter tiles crack and crumble when they are used up, giving each puzzle a distinctive visual rhythm. Enjoy the word-finding challenge and the satisfying break-apart moments along the way.

LARGE LETTERS, READABLE COUNTS
See the letters and remaining-use numbers clearly as you study the board. Compare possible connections, choose a word, and make your next move.

If you enjoy crossword games and connecting letters, try a word puzzle where finding an answer and choosing a path go hand in hand.

Connect the letters. Complete the crossword. Enjoy the crumble.

apps.title: Factifact: Trivia Word Puzzle
apps.summary:
Factifact is a trivia word puzzle that turns fun facts into wordplay. 🔍 Each short fact hides some of its words inside brackets. Read the definitions, find the missing words and reveal the whole fact.

How does a Factifact word game work? A fact appears with some words, or parts of words, hidden in brackets. Each bracket holds a short definition of a missing word. Read it and guess the word from four options. No typing is needed, so these logic puzzles stay smooth and focused. Definitions are nested three or four layers deep. The answer to an inner definition becomes a word in the outer one. It feels like trivia questions stacked inside each other. Every word you find brings you closer to interesting facts about the world. 🧠 Think of them as word riddles that test your vocabulary.

Factifact works like a reverse crossword without a grid. ⛏️ Classic crossword puzzles give you a clue and a row of empty squares. Here you start from the clue and dig down to the hidden word. Fans of word puzzle games will feel at home right away. Every brainteaser blends vocabulary, reasoning and general knowledge in one sequence. Short brain teasers like these make a calm mental workout at any time.

Guess the word correctly and the next layer of the puzzle opens. Unlike most word quiz games, every answer becomes part of the next clue. These trivia questions reward careful reading and patient thinking. Solving puzzles here feels like piecing a small story together. What you will find inside:
💡 A hint when a clue feels too tricky
❤️ Three hearts per fact, so every guess counts
🏺 A dig site that uncovers a hidden find with each solved word
📌 A board where every solved fact is pinned as a colorful note
🎉 Confetti, fireworks and kind words when a fact is fully revealed

The facts cover nature, geography, animals and much more. 🏺 One puzzle explains why honey can stay fresh for centuries. Another shows how Mount Everest is still growing. If you enjoy crossword puzzles, these little discoveries will surprise you. Factifact brings word puzzle games and general knowledge together. Expect brain teasers that are short, fair and satisfying to crack.

Facts unlock one after another, and any solved fact can be reread later. 📌 Some logic puzzles are gentle, while others are real brainteasers with deep nesting. A wrong answer costs a heart, so read each clue carefully. Love word quiz games, solving puzzles and interesting facts? 🎉 Factifact is waiting for you.

apps.title: Word Mahjong - Relaxing Puzzle
apps.summary:
Take a break, connect some letters, and enjoy a little wordplay with Word Mahjong!

Word Mahjong is a relaxing word puzzle game that’s easy to learn and fun to master. With clever puzzles and peaceful backgrounds, it’s a welcoming place to unwind and put your vocabulary to the test.

There’s no timer and no pressure to rush. Take your time, explore different letter combinations, and enjoy the satisfaction of finding the word that completes the puzzle.

HOW TO PLAY

Connect letter tiles to form words and fill every blank on the board. Each tile has a small number showing how many times you need to use that letter. Keep an eye on these numbers as you work through each puzzle—they add a thoughtful twist to classic crossword gameplay!

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORD MAHJONG

• Simple to start, satisfying to master
Learn the basics quickly, then discover new challenges as you progress.

• Hundreds of word puzzles
Explore increasingly challenging levels that put your spelling and vocabulary to the test.

• Play at your own pace
Enjoy every puzzle without time limits, whether you have a few minutes or a whole evening.

• Peaceful, beautiful backgrounds
Settle into calming scenery while you search for your next word.

• Fun for all ages
From casual players to longtime word puzzle fans, everyone can enjoy the pleasure of solving a clever puzzle.

If you enjoy crosswords, word connect games, or simply a quiet moment with words, make Word Mahjong part of your day.

Download Word Mahjong and start connecting. How many words will you discover?

apps.title: Transformers: Eternal War
apps.summary:
Autobots and Decepticons stand united against the Chaos Legion! Experience an all-new Transformers Strategy Idle RPG featuring an original story by Simon Furman!

The Earth has been consumed by a mysterious force born from pure chaos energy—an unstoppable corruption now spreading toward humanity’s final line of defense.
For generations, Autobots and Decepticons have waged an unrelenting war. But in the face of the Chaos Legion—as heroes and villains fight against the chaos—old enmities must be set aside.
The fight for Earth is no longer about victory. It is about survival.

◆ Forge an Original Transformers Epic with Simon Furman ◆
Transformers: Eternal War features an original story written by Simon Furman, the legendary writer who helped define the Transformers universe for generations of fans.
In this all-new chapter, players will uncover the rise of the Chaos Legion, an apocalyptic faction empowered by unstable chaos energy. As its influence spreads, iconic Autobots and Decepticons must unite against a corruption threatening Earth, Cybertron, and the future of the universe.
Faced with a threat unlike anything they have ever encountered, Autobots and Decepticons must confront an impossible choice: continue their endless war—or stand together to protect Earth, Cybertron, and the future of all they fight for.

◆ Lead the Combat Through Strategic Command ◆
Transformers: Eternal War evolves the character-collector experience with a streamlined system focused on tactical squad-building and strategic progression over constant micromanagement.
Whether online or away from the battlefield, your forces continue fighting, gathering resources, and advancing the war effort around the clock. Recruit, upgrade, and command an ever-expanding roster of iconic Transformers while assembling powerful team synergies capable of turning the tide of battle.
Every squad composition matters. Every commander shapes the future of the conflict.

◆ Build the Ark. Sustain the Battle. ◆
Beyond the battlefield, players can expand and manage support facilities surrounding the Ark, creating a steady flow of resources that keeps their forces combat-ready at all times.
By upgrading automated production systems and optimizing resource operations, commanders can continuously strengthen their squads. Even while offline, your facilities remain active—gathering supplies, supporting troop growth, and preparing your forces for the next conflict.
Designed around a seamless hands-off experience, Transformers: Eternal War allows players to focus less on repetitive maintenance and more on assembling powerful teams, developing strategy, and pushing back against the growing Chaos Legion threat.

◆ A New Era of Transformers Warfare Begins ◆
Combining legendary characters, an original story crafted by one of the franchise’s most iconic writers, and a modern strategic gameplay experience built for mobile, Transformers: Eternal War delivers both a celebration of Transformers history and a bold new evolution for the franchise.

——The universe is changing.
——The signal has been broadcast.
——Now the fate of Earth depends on who answers the call！

apps.title: Tidy Room!
apps.summary:
A bedroom floor full of stray things. A kitchen counter lost under mugs. A study where nothing made it back to the shelf. Tidy Room! hands you the mess and a few baskets, and asks you to put it right.

Each basket names what it wants. Hunt through the room, tap the right things, and watch the clutter disappear. Objects hide under other objects, so the fun is in the order: what do you pick up first?

Play at your own pace. There is no countdown, just a room that looks better every time you find the thing a basket asked for.

What you will do
• Explore illustrated rooms, from quiet studies to busy kitchens
• Fill baskets by finding the items they ask for
• Dig through piles to reach what is hidden underneath
• Plan your taps so the tray does not overflow
• Clear one level and start the next

One room at a time, until the house feels like home again.

apps.summary:
Welcome to Arrow Story: Home Design! A relaxing arrow puzzle game that trains your brain.
SOS! A woman and her dog lost their home to a fire. A family is caught in a blizzard. They need your help.
Come to Arrow Story: Home Design. Solve arrow puzzles, collect stars, and help people in need rebuild their homes and get back to happy lives.
It's a heartfelt arrow puzzle game where every level brings a change you can see. Spend the stars you earn to repair their broken homes until the place looks new again. One repair at a time, you put their lives back together.
➡️ Arrow Puzzle Gameplay
Arrows cover every grid, and each one can only travel the way it points. That means one arrow can block another. Study the layout, spot which arrows are in the way, and find the order that clears the board.
An arrow leaves once its path is open. Tap a blocked one and it counts as a mistake. Every level pays 1 to 3 stars, and fewer mistakes mean more stars. Stars are your score and your building budget. Every star moves the story forward, and the more you earn, the faster you can build. Fail a level and you lose a heart. Early levels teach the rules. Later ones make you think. Hard and super-hard levels put your planning to the test.
💡 Helpers for Tricky Grids
A tight grid doesn't have to stop you. Four helpers are ready: Hint, Eraser, Magic Wand, and Full Grid Zoom.
✨ Why Choose Arrow Story: Home Design
• ⭐ Arrow puzzles with a real payoff: every grid you clear pays stars
• 🔨 Builds you can see: every repair brings the place closer to new, and helps someone who needs it
• ☕ No rush: no timer, so you can take all the time you need
• 📴 Offline play: works without Wi-Fi or mobile data

apps.title: Hidden Christmas: Find Objects
apps.summary:
Search festive pictures and find hidden objects in Hidden Christmas: Find Objects. Zoom into snowy villages, cozy cabins, and decorated homes, then tap each item on your list. No timer. Play at your own pace.

🎄 How to play
Each scene shows the objects you need to find. Pinch to zoom, drag across the picture, and tap what you spot. Some items sit in plain sight. Others blend into the lights, gifts, and furniture, so the fun is in looking twice. If you get stuck, use a hint and keep going.

A round is simple. Open a Christmas picture, check the list, and search until every object is found. Larger items help you settle in. Smaller ones ask for a closer look. When the list is clear, move on to the next scene. Nothing is counting down while you search.

🎅 Christmas scenes to explore
Move through snowy villages, Christmas workshops, gift-filled rooms, glowing streets, and warm living rooms. You will see sparkling trees, snowy rooftops, festive windows, and rooms full of holiday color.

The pictures are not copies of one living room. A quiet cabin, a busy workshop, a decorated dining room, and a street lined with lights each hide objects in different places. The clutter, the colors, and the corners worth checking all change.

🎁 What you will find
Look for the details that make a scene feel like Christmas: ornaments, wrapped presents, candy canes, stockings, bells, wreaths, gingerbread, and snowflakes. Santa, elves, reindeer, and snowmen show up among the garlands, along with mittens, scarves, snow globes, and pine trees.

Check the mantel, the table, the windowsill, and the edge of the room. Holiday objects sit inside the picture, mixed in with decorations, furniture, and wrapped gifts.

❄️ A calm Christmas hidden object game
Hidden Christmas is a relaxing seek-and-find game for a short break or a longer cozy session. Finish one list, then come back later for another winter scene.

It is an easy holiday puzzle when you want something festive without a timer, and a closer search when you feel like examining every corner. Play for a few minutes, or stay with a picture until the last object turns up.

If you like Christmas games, hidden object puzzles, and holiday seek-and-find pictures, start with one scene and see what you notice.

apps.title: The Last Walk: Survival Story
apps.summary:
The Last Walk is a zombie survival story game with real choices, set in a post-apocalyptic world. The army is evacuating the last civilians. Your wife and daughter climb onto the last truck. There is no room for you.

So you walk. Through dead suburbs, empty highways and burnt-out towns, all the way to the coast, across the sea, onto an island under siege, and beyond. More than 30 days of walking through a world overrun by zombies, and the story isn't over yet.

EVERY ENCOUNTER IS A CHOICE
A wounded stranger begs for a bandage. A lost child is starving. Raiders block the road. A bear escaped from the zoo sleeps across your path. A supermarket hands out free food, a little too freely. Swipe left or right: help or walk away, fight or run, trust or lie. Every choice changes your supplies, your health and the man you become.

SURVIVE THE ROAD
- Manage water, food and health: the road drains them every hour.
- Search the ruins, then buy and sell gear at the traders and markets.
- Arm yourself: nail bat, crowbar, machete, revolver, pump shotgun. Upgrade and reload them at the traders.
- Find a shelter before nightfall, or spend the night outside and fight the zombies, the Prowlers, until dawn.
- Meet people who walk with you for a while, and a stray dog who could change everything.

A FATHER'S STORY
Your family is alive, somewhere ahead. Keep your humanity or keep everything for yourself: the people you help, the ones you leave behind and the risks you take decide where your story goes.

MORE STORIES IN THE SAME WORLD
Other survivors walk other roads. Their stories take place in the same world and cross the main story. Unlock them by playing the main story or by paying.

FEATURES
- A zombie survival game and an interactive story, with real choices and no right answer
- More than 30 days of walking, and the story continues
- Several more stories to unlock by playing the main story or by paying
- Night fights, markets, weapons to upgrade and supplies to manage
- A side-scrolling pixel-art world with animated scenes
- Free to play, in short sessions
- Available in 31 languages

apps.title: Gloamguard
apps.summary:
At dusk the Gloam rolls over Mirefield and the dead get up. One war wagon still holds the road. Keep it whole.

Gloamguard is a side-on lane defense game in a grim medieval land. Valor fills on its own and sends fighters off the wagon. Every kill feeds Wrath, which drops casks on the road. Break the bone barricade before the Gloamed break the wagon, then spend your silver and march on.

THREE ACTS, THIRTY MISSIONS
Start in the Fields with Tam, a peasant with a pitchfork, and a plain cart with one lantern. Cross Saint Odo's Lands, where more of the dead are spirits. End on the Corpse Road, at the abbey door, where the Plague Abbot raises his wards.

WHAT YOU DO
• Send six fighters down the road: Tam's pitchfork, Old Hobb's sling, Wat's maul, Rudd's axe, Sister Agna's slowing shot, Hale's torch
• Drop oak casks to crush the dead, pitch casks to burn them, a healer's satchel to keep your line standing
• Tap fallen standards for Valor; keep the wagon untouched for all three sigils
• Raise the war wagon through ten levels, from a plain cart to an iron-clad hood
• From Mission 20, a scorpion on its roof (level 8) looses a volley at full Wrath
• Level your fighters with silver and training writs; climb ten Renown ranks
• Meet eight kinds of Gloamed, from the howling Gloamrunner to the Wailing widow, who breaks fighters' nerve

THE MIST AND THE STORY
Burn lamp oil to clear the map's mist: it hides caches, four side quests and the Toll House, a trial in three levels. Twelve scenes play out on the road before their fights, from fighters joining the company to a bell ringing in an empty tower. The Gloamed book keeps a page for each kind of dead you meet.

NOTHING TO BUY
Lamp oil lights the way: a battle takes 2 and a misty tile takes 1. The tank holds 20 and refills a drop every 10 minutes, even while the game is closed, and each Renown rank fills it again. There is no shop and no oil for sale. A defeat costs nothing more: the Defeat screen names the upgrade you are missing and takes you to it. Stuck? Replay an earlier mission for silver and Renown, train, come back.

HOW IT PLAYS
Battles take a few minutes, in landscape, with taps and one drag. Dunstan, the old crossbowman on the wagon's roof, shoots on his own and teaches each new thing once.

GOOD TO KNOW
No ads and no in-app purchases. Battles need no internet connection. The game uses analytics to see how missions play; in the EU, EEA, UK and Switzerland it asks for consent first. Progress stays on your device. English only.

apps.summary:
OSCO Games بيحوّل أي خناقة كورة لبرنامج مسابقات.

لعبتين في أوضة واحدة. العبوا على تليفون واحد بتتناقلوه، أو كل واحد على تليفونه — ابعت كود الأوضة وكلكم جوه.

تعمل صفقة ولا تغامر؟
صناديق مقفولة، وفي كل صندوق لاعب. تفتح صندوق ويبقى قدامك قرار: تضمّه لتشكيلتك، ولا ترجّعه وتغامر على الصندوق اللي بعده. كمّل مراكزك قبل ما الباقيين يكمّلوا. وكروت الدرع والسرقة ولبس صاحبك مستنية تقلب الماتش في آخر ثانية.

كوّن فريق
كل مركز له شرط — جنسية، دوري، نادي. كلكم بتجاوبوا في نفس الوقت، محدش شايف إجابة التاني، والكشف هو اللي بيحكم. أعلى مجموع في الهدف ياخد البطولة.

اللي جوه التطبيق
• من ٢ لـ ٨ لاعيبة
• تليفون واحد بتتناقلوه، أو أوضة كل واحد فيها على تليفونه
• ادخل بكود الأوضة، أو اتفرّج على الأوض العامة، أو خليها خاصة لشلتك
• كروت: درع، سرقة، لبس صاحبك
• جولات بوقت أو من غير وقت — الوقت بإيدك
• ضيّق اختيار اللاعيبة بالدوري أو النادي أو الجنسية
• آلاف اللاعيبة والأندية، بتتحدّث مع المواسم
• نقاط خبرة وترتيب عام

معلومات اللاعبين والأندية جاية من قواعد بيانات كورة عامة وبتتحدّث مع المواسم. التطبيق مش تابع لأي نادي أو اتحاد أو بطولة أو أي برنامج تليفزيوني.
apps.description:
OSCO Games turns any football fight into a game show.

Two games in one room. Play on one phone you share, or each on their own—send the room code and you're all in.

Make a deal or take a risk?

Closed boxes, each containing a player. Open a box and you have a decision: add them to your squad, or return them and take a chance on the next box. Complete your positions before everyone else does. Shield, steal, and your friend's outfit cards are waiting to turn the tide of the match at the last second.

Build a team!
Each position has a requirement—nationality, league, club. You all answer at the same time, no one can see each other's answers, and the score is the deciding factor. The player with the highest goal tally wins the championship.

What's inside the app:

• 2 to 8 players
• One phone to share, or a room for each player on their own phone
• Enter with a room code, browse public rooms, or keep them private for your group
• Cards: Shield, Steal, Your Friend's Outfit
• Timed or Untimed Matches — The timing is up to you
• Narrow down your player selection by league, club, or nationality
• Thousands of players and clubs, updated with the seasons
• Experience points and overall ranking

Player and club information comes from general football databases and is updated with the seasons. The app is not affiliated with any club, federation, tournament, or television program.

apps.title: AutoRace: Idle Racing
apps.summary:
AutoRace is a one-thumb racing game. Your car drives itself – you choose when to switch lanes, when to hit the turbo and which skill card to take.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap the left or right side of the screen to switch lanes
• Nail the turbo at the start for a flying launch
• At each gate, pick 1 of 3 skill cards and turn the race around
• Every race is a fight for position all the way to the flag

BUILD YOUR CAR
• Upgrade five parts: engine, body, tyres, front wing and rear wing
• Merge two parts of the same grade into a stronger one, up to grade 13
• Each part improves one stat, so you can feel every upgrade on track

RECRUIT DRIVERS
• 16 drivers with their own skill cards – rarer drivers add a special skill
• Raise driver mastery to unlock new skills and stat boosts
• Check your drivers' condition before the green light

CLIMB THE LEAGUES
• Race from Bronze to Champion across 30 stages
• Take on the Grand Prix Challenge: 16 racers, no cards, pure racing
• Earn extra rewards from the Racing Pass and daily missions

QUICK RACES, REAL TRACKS
• Circuits modelled on the layouts of famous race tracks
• Races take just a few minutes – perfect for a quick break

Start your engine and race to the top!

apps.title: Fast Cash Word Yatzy
apps.summary:
Fast Cash Word Yatzy is the word game that can actually pay off.

Take the word board from your favorite classic board games, mix in the dice rolling fun of Yatzy, and you get Word Yatzy. Now you can also earn cash rewards just for playing.

How to play:
- Start each round with 7 letters. Make words and play them on the board for points.
- Don't like your letters? Roll them like dice and go for something better.
- Put the big letters (hello Z and Q) on bonus tiles for huge rounds.
- Fill all 5 slots and you get a +100 bonus.
- Games are only 5 rounds, so you can finish one in a few minutes and start the next.
- There's no timer on your moves. Play at your own pace.

Earn while you play:
- Play the game you already love and earn cash rewards along the way.
- Once you reach the minimum, cash out and keep going for the next one.

More ways to play:
- Duels: Go one on one against real players and see who has the better vocabulary.
- Leagues: Climb the rankings and show everyone what you've got.
- Daily challenges and events: Something new to play every day.
- Achievements: Hit milestones and collect rewards along the way.
- Friends and family: Play with people you know, or get matched with someone new. There's always somebody ready for a game.

It's perfect for those "waiting for the bus" moments, and it gives your brain a real workout while you're at it.

Think you have the words and the luck to beat your opponent? Download Fast Cash Word Yatzy and start earning.

apps.title: Mahjong Pair Crush

Mahjong Pair Crush: Classic Tile Matching Puzzle 🀄🧩

Unwind with Mahjong Pair Crush, a polished mahjong solitaire game for casual players and puzzle lovers who enjoy satisfying tile-pair elimination. This timeless board puzzle blends classic mahjong solitaire rules with smooth, crush-style matching fun, letting you clear intricate layouts at your own relaxed pace, no stressful timers.

Built on traditional mahjong solitaire mechanics: find pairs of free tiles that are not blocked from the top or sides, match them to remove, and clear every tile on the board to complete the level. Hundreds of uniquely designed puzzle levels await you. Enjoy quick 5-minute casual rounds during breaks, or dive into longer puzzle sessions. Fresh daily mahjong challenges bring brand-new tile structures every day, helping you practice pattern recognition and sharpen your logic skills gradually.

✅ Authentic classic mahjong solitaire pair matching rules
✅ Hundreds of handmade puzzle levels with progressive difficulty
✅ Daily challenges with brand-new tile layouts
✅ No countdown timers — play with zero time pressure
✅ Fully offline gameplay, no network required
✅ Large clear tiles and simple intuitive controls
✅ Light strategy puzzle fun for all ages & skill levels
✅ Smooth tile crush effects for satisfying matching moments

If you are a fan of mahjong solitaire, tile matching and relaxing brain puzzles, Mahjong Pair Crush is made for you. Download now and start your mahjong pair crush adventure today!

apps.title: Just a Squire
apps.summary:
You’re just a squire.

Do the chores. Earn your wages. Buy and merge powerful skills. Transform against impossible odds. Fall in love. And somehow… save the kingdom that ignored you.

All while everyone else gets the glory.

WELCOME TO JUST A SQUIRE

Just a Squire is a story-driven roguelite RPG about an underappreciated squire determined to prove that even the most ordinary person can become a hero.

Your adventure begins with simple duties and a knight who expects far too much. But when strange enemies appear and a mysterious power awakens within you, carrying the bags becomes the least of your problems.

TURN CHORES INTO GOLD

A squire’s work is never finished. At least this time, you’re getting paid.

Tackle playful timing and physics-based mini-games that turn everyday duties into satisfying challenges. Aim carefully, time your moves and earn gold for your hard work. Apparently, saving the kingdom doesn’t excuse you from chores.

BUY, MERGE AND CHOOSE YOUR SKILLS

Build your strategy as each chapter unfolds. Buy skills, merge them into stronger versions and choose combinations that work together.

Spend wisely, adapt to the skills on offer and decide which upgrades deserve your gold. Your next purchase could bring the whole build together.

UNLEASH YOUR TRANSFORMATIONS

Discover different Squire Forms and awaken powerful transformations at unforgettable story moments. Explore new looks, reveal the strength hiding inside you and show everyone what a “mere squire” can really do.

You might look a little different afterward. The chores will still be waiting.

MAKE YOUR SQUIRE YOUR OWN

Collect and upgrade equipment, try different combinations and give your squire a look worth remembering.

Discover Fate gear inspired by the different lives your squire could have lived. From humble jobs to distinctive clans, each look brings another possibility to your adventure. Apparently, being underappreciated comes in several outfits.

COLLECT PETS, MOUNTS AND SENTINELS

Expand your collection with charming pets, impressive mounts and powerful sentinels. Find your favorites and give your adventure a little more company.

Even a squire deserves someone on their side.

TAKE ON SOLO CHALLENGES AND PVP

Venture beyond the story with single-player modes and test your strength against other players in PvP battles.

Put your growing collection and carefully chosen upgrades to work across different challenges. Fight through beautiful fantasy arenas, face strange enemies and find more reasons to get stronger.

LIVE YOUR OWN FANTASY STORY

Meet memorable heroes, rivals, inventors, knights and monsters across unfolding chapters. Survive your knight’s increasingly ridiculous requests. Form unexpected friendships. Fall in love.

Uncover the truth behind a growing darkness and become the unlikely hero standing between the kingdom and an ancient evil.

You may begin as the least important person in the kingdom…

But you won’t stay that way for long.

apps.title: Astrobark
apps.summary:
Humanity’s future is in your paws! 🐾

Become Hart Von-Bark — a brave dog who wakes from cryosleep aboard a damaged spaceship. Gather resources, upgrade your weapons and tools, repair the ship, and rescue your friends in this space-themed idle arcade adventure!

Humanity has lost the war against the machines. Its last hope is the Phoenix Protocol — a collection of knowledge and technology that could rebuild civilisation. Your ship was carrying it to a distant refuge when an ambush near the asteroid Outpost K-9 brought the mission to a halt.

Now the ship’s systems are down, the crew is missing, and Captain Zepp is calling from the locked bridge. It’s time to take matters into your own paws!

Gather Resources and Upgrade Your Gear
Explore the ship in search of materials. Improve your tools and weapons to tackle new obstacles and dangers.

Bring the Ship Back to Life
Repair equipment, restore power, and open paths to new compartments. Every restored system brings you closer to saving the captain and getting the ship moving again.

Find Six Energy Crystals
The Prism Engine cannot start without them. Recover the lost crystals to power the engine and continue your journey.

Rescue Your Crewmates
Find Alto, Muffin, and Bolt — intelligent dogs who are also trapped aboard. Explore the ship’s compartments and uncover what happened after the ambush.

The captain needs your help, and humanity needs a second chance. Repair the ship, save the crew, and deliver the Phoenix Protocol to safety!

apps.summary:
Sweet Spot: Thrilling Visual Spot-the-Difference Adventure
Fed up with ordinary find-the-difference games? Come explore Sweet Spot! This high-definition visual puzzle game blends laid-back leisure fun with mind-teasing challenges. Hunt for carefully concealed tiny differences within gorgeous illustrations and dynamic video clips to hone your observation and quick response skills, and enjoy delightful puzzle entertainment whenever and wherever you want.

### Two Game Modes for Seamless Switching
**Still Image Mode (Casual Relaxation)**
Huge library of HD static puzzle levels with zero time limits. Take all the time you need to spot subtle distinctions in texture, lighting, color and fine details. Ideal for unwinding during breaks and practicing your observation skills without pressure.

**Live Video Mode (Reaction Challenge)**
Found static puzzles too simple? Try fast-paced video challenges. Spot momentary differences in moving footage to put your eyesight and reflexes to the test. You receive 3 free attempts each day. Once these are used up, view short ads to gain extra tries.

### Reward & Unlock System
Beat levels to unlock exclusive bonus videos and expand your gameplay experience. Two ways to unlock content:
- Free Path: Watch short video advertisements to unlock bonus videos
- VIP Benefits: Subscribe to VIP to instantly unlock all bonus videos and play without ads

### In-Game Content Gallery
The built-in gallery automatically stores every unlocked image and bonus video. You can view and sort your collection at any time, and save your favorite materials locally to keep them forever.

### Core Highlights
- Premium HD Visual Quality: Carefully refined art resources offer sharp, rich graphics for an amazing visual experience
- Carefully Tuned Difficulty Gradient: Easy for new players to get started, while seasoned puzzle enthusiasts can get satisfying challenges
- Immersive Sound Design: Calming background music matched with clear in-game feedback sound effects
- Ongoing Content Updates: Fresh levels and artworks are added on a regular basis

### Suitable for All Casual Gamers
Whether you are a puzzle fan, looking to relieve stress, or love beautiful visuals, this game will bring you joy. Simple, easy-to-use controls make it a perfect lightweight game to relax and exercise your eyesight.

### Service Promise
Sweet Spot follows positive and compliant service specifications. Focused on aesthetic enjoyment and observation training, all game content complies with platform rules. We rigorously safeguard user privacy and continuously polish game quality to provide a smooth, enjoyable gaming environment for every player.

Sort, match, and arrange colorful flowers in a satisfying sorting puzzle adventure!

Sort Streak is a relaxing color sorting puzzle game and matching game that combines simple drag-and-drop gameplay with thoughtful planning. Colorful flowers are arranged on ropes, and your goal is to sort flowers by color, match them to the right rope, complete objectives, and fill flower pots.

The gameplay is easy to learn, but every move matters. Rearrange the flowers, manage limited rope space, and find the best solution for every puzzle level. Whether you want to relax or train your logical thinking, Sort Streak offers a colorful and satisfying puzzle challenge.

🎮 HOW TO PLAY

• Pick up a flower or a connected group of flowers from a rope.
• Drag the flowers onto an empty rope.
• You can also place them onto a rope with the same color at its free end and enough space.
• Sort and match flowers by color while carefully planning each move.
• Complete a full group of flowers on the matching rope.
• Watch the completed group collect into a flower pot.
• Complete all objectives and fill the required pots to clear the level.

Every move can change the entire board. Look ahead, rearrange the flowers, and use the available rope space wisely. If there are no legal moves left, the level ends. Can you overcome every sorting challenge and complete the objectives?

• Relaxing color sorting gameplay that is easy to learn.
• Simple drag-and-drop controls for an intuitive matching game experience.
• Colorful flowers, ropes, and satisfying sorting animations.
• Puzzle levels ranging from easy introductions to challenging arrangements.
• Different levels and layouts that keep the sorting adventure fresh.
• Helpful tools, including Hint, Undo, and Add a Rope.

apps.title: Color Link 2048: Lucky Link
apps.summary:
Welcome to Glow Merge: Color Link 2048 — a fresh and colorful twist on the classic 2048 puzzle!
In Glow Merge, the board is filled with vibrant glowing tiles in different colors. Your mission is simple: connect tiles of the same color and merge them into higher numbers, just like 2048 — but with a colorful glowing twist! Tap to link matching colors, watch them merge and glow even brighter, and climb your way all the way to 2048 and beyond. The more you merge, the more dazzling the board becomes!

How to Play:

• Tap a tile to select it
• Tap an adjacent tile of the same color to link them together
• Linked tiles merge into one tile with a higher number
• Keep merging strategically to reach the highest number possible
• Be careful — the board fills up fast, so plan ahead!

Power-Ups:

Shuffle — Stuck with no good moves? Use Shuffle to rearrange all tiles on the board, giving you a completely fresh set of possibilities. It's your second chance when the board looks blocked.

Magnet — Need a specific color to complete a merge? Magnet pulls all tiles of the chosen color closer together on the board, making merges much easier. Use it wisely at critical moments!

Game Features:

Hundreds of hand-crafted levels with increasing difficulty — from easy to brain-breaking
Beautiful glowing graphics with vibrant colors that are easy on the eyes
Relaxing background music to help you stay calm and focused
No time limit — think as long as you need
Track your highest score and progress over time
Fully offline — no WiFi required
Suitable for all ages — kids and adults alike will love it

Tips & Tricks:

Always scan the board for the biggest possible merge first
Use Shuffle early if the board looks blocked or unbalanced
Save Magnet for critical moments when you need a specific color
Try to keep the board balanced — avoid clustering too many tiles of one color
Think 2-3 moves ahead for the best results
Why Play GlowMerge?

GlowMerge takes the addictive 2048 formula and wraps it in a colorful, connected world. It's a brain-training experience disguised as a casual game. Whether you're commuting, taking a break, or just killing time, GlowMerge gives your brain a fun and gentle workout. Puzzle games like this can sharpen memory, improve focus, and boost problem-solving skills.

The difficulty ramps up gradually. Early levels are simple and satisfying, but later levels will truly test your strategy and patience. Every level is solvable — you just need to think ahead and use your power-ups wisely.

New levels are added regularly, so the challenge never ends.

Download GlowMerge now and start your colorful merging journey!

apps.title: Sand Hole: Block Sort Jam
apps.summary:
Sort colored sand, free your blocks, and fill every one of them to 100%. Sand Hole: Block Sort Jam is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the sand really moves.

HOW IT WORKS
Every level gives you framed panels full of colored sand and a board full of colored blocks. Drag a block until it touches sand of its own color and it starts pulling that sand in, grain by grain. Fill a block to 100% and it pops off the board, freeing space for the rest. Clear all the sand and the level is yours.

One finger, one gesture. Drag. That is the whole control scheme.

THE SAND DOES THE WORK
This sand is not a flat picture. Pull from underneath a pile and it funnels down into a V. Pull from the side and the slope above it slides. A steep, sharp edge will stand there until something gives, then collapse all at once. Drain the same panel in a different order and it falls apart differently.

A REAL PUZZLE UNDER THE COLORS
Blocks cannot pass through each other, and a long shape wedged in a corridor stays wedged. So the order you complete blocks in is the actual puzzle: read the board, spot the block that frees the most room, and work outward from there.

Boards come in every shape, from open grids to narrow corridors and split chambers, and later levels keep several sand panels going at once. Some blocks even hold a second color inside: the inner layer fills first, then the outer one takes over.

The timer only starts when you make your first move, so study the board as long as you want before you touch anything.

BOOSTERS FOR THE TIGHT SPOTS
Hammer: splits a stuck block into single cells that slip through any gap.
Magnet: fills the selected block instantly and pops it.
Time Freeze: stops the clock while everything else keeps running.

FEATURES
- Satisfying color sort puzzle built on real sand physics
- Drag only controls, playable with one thumb
- Blocks in every shape: bars, squares, L shapes, T shapes
- Boards that keep changing shape: corridors, chambers, open grids
- Multiple sand panels running at the same time in later levels
- Bright pixel style sand in clean, saturated colors
- Three boosters: Hammer, Magnet, Time Freeze
- No wall of tutorials, you learn it in one drag

Drag, pull, pop. Your satisfying sand sort puzzle is ready when you are.

apps.title: Street League Football
apps.summary:
Arcade American football on a street field, where every catch, tackle and juke comes from physics. Chase a high score in Endless, take the hit in Tackle Alley, and win 1v1 route battles online or against the CPU.

Players' bodies and the ball actually collide, so no two plays look the same. Run up a wall, go up one-handed over a defender, or truck the tackler and keep going.

MODES
- Endless: CPU opponents get tougher every round. Three strikes and you're out. Play offense, defense or both and climb the global leaderboards.
- Tackle Alley: carry the ball through a lane of tacklers, or line up as the defender and stop the runner.
- Route Battle 1 on 1: receiver against corner, eight reps, roles swap every two. Play online multiplayer with quick match or a room code, or take on four CPU difficulties.
- 3 on 3: squads, rush counts and route calls, online or against the CPU. Still being built.
- Practice: kickoff returns, quarterback drills and route work.

FREE TO START
The free download includes the tutorial, Tackle Alley with one tackler, Route Battle 1 on 1 against Rookie and Street CPU opponents, and the replay editor. One Full Game purchase unlocks Endless, 3 on 3, kickoff returns, quarterback and route practice, online play, more Tackle Alley defenders, and Legend and Insane CPU difficulty. No ads and no subscriptions. Restore Purchases is in Settings.

MORE
- Replay editor: rewatch any play from new camera angles in slow motion, then save and export the clip.
- Locker: build your player's body, head, hair, gear, cleats and colors.
- Touch controls built for landscape, with a layout editor to move every button. Controllers work too.
- Cross-platform online matches.

Online play needs an internet connection and uses Epic Online Services. Found a problem? Use the in-game Feedback button.

apps.title: King Dies Rich: Roguelike TD
apps.summary:
The king will fall. His fortune won't.

King Dies Rich is a pixel-art roguelike tower defense where the king himself is the tower. Hold the throne against the undead, find powerful loot, and turn every defeat into a stronger kingdom: castle defense, roguelite, and RPG in one game.

HOLD THE THRONE
Your king stays on his throne as enemies close in from every side. Slide a finger to guide the attack circle while he strikes automatically. Pick the most dangerous targets, break up the horde, and survive the next boss. Choose drag or direct touch aiming to suit your play style.

SEVEN SCHOOLS OF POWER
Shape your build with Fire, Frost, Poison, Lightning, Guard, Blades, and Spirits. Burn the undead, freeze a crowd, unleash chain lightning, or surround the throne with blades and spirit archers. Equip matching gear to unlock Mastery and Dominion powers, from falling meteors to volleys of spectral arrows.

LOOT, EQUIP, REFORGE
Collect gear with different bonuses and school effects. Compare finds, equip legendary items, upgrade your favorites, and reforge their properties. Set gems in the throne and combine them into stronger gems as your Kingdom develops.

BUILD A LASTING KINGDOM
Spend the gold you earn on the Arsenal, Citadel, Treasury, Forge, and Mines. Buildings provide lasting upgrades and unlock more ways to improve your king. Your gold, gear, gems, and Kingdom progress stay with you when a siege ends, even if the king falls.

DEEPER HALLS, DEADLIER BOSSES
Battle through the Throne Hall, Crypt, and Chapel. Defeat each hall's boss to open the next, then face tougher enemies in the next circle. Discover the Bone Giant, the Maned and Chained Ghouls, and the Mourner. Fill your Bestiary as you learn what each enemy can do.

KING OF KINGS
After the first circle, King of Kings opens: the weekly race. Compete with other kings and climb from the Bronze league to the Crown league.

PLAY OFFLINE
An offline game for phones and tablets in landscape, with touch controls, adjustable sound, and optional vibration. Only the weekly race needs an internet connection. No account required.

Hold a little longer. Find a better crown. Die rich.

apps.title: Crowd Theory
apps.summary:
How well do you know the crowd?

Every day, one question. Answer it honestly for yourself - then the real game: predict what percent of everyone else said the same. Lock your guess, no takebacks, and watch the reveal - the crowd's true number, live, and your score is how far away you are. 2% away? You can read the room. 45% off? Maybe you've been living under a rock.

THE DAILY RITUAL

• One new question every day at 4pm ET - everyone plays the same 24-hour window
• Questions you can't help guessing: What percent of people think they're better-than-average drivers? What percent refrigerate ketchup? What percent fart in front of their spouse? What percent say please and thank you to AI?
• Live crowd numbers that move as votes come in

SEE WHO SAID WHAT

• Demographic breakdowns: how men, women, and every generation answered
• Daily takeaways on where the crowd split
• Every question ends in a conversation with the whole crowd

START A LEAGUE

• Your own private leaderboard with your group chat, your family, your office
• One link invites them - friends who have the app land straight in your league
• Finally settle who actually knows how people think

CLIMB THE BOARDS

• Today, 7-day, 30-day, and all-time leaderboards with your real rank
• Streaks, badges, and your Crowd DNA - discover how much you're actually like everyone else in Your Story

PLAY THE BACK CATALOG

Missed a day? Every past question is still playable. The crowd is locked - your read isn't.

Anonymous by design - no email to play, no ads, no trackers. We will never sell your personal information or let anyone target you based on what you answered.

Every day on the road brings a new decision. Risk it all for a rare reward or play it safe and move on? Your choices in these random encounters shape every run. It is a dangerous walking dead world out there, but taking risks is the only way to progress in this deep roguelike pixel rpg.

apps.title: Idle Mining & Refining
apps.summary:
Turn raw ore into profit in Ore Mining & Refining, a relaxing idle game filled with moving machines, satisfying crushing and rewarding upgrades!

Tap to drop ore from above and watch it travel through your production line. Pistons, spinning mechanisms and conveyors push each piece toward the crusher, where raw ore becomes valuable metal. Your robots carry the finished metal to the bank, earning you money to upgrade your machines and keep production growing.

⛏️ TAP AND KEEP THE ORE FLOWING

Every production run starts with raw ore. Tap to drop more pieces onto the level and watch your machines move them along. Follow their journey from rough rocks to refined metal!

⚙️ WATCH YOUR MACHINES AT WORK

Let pistons push, mechanisms spin and conveyors carry your ore toward the crusher. Enjoy watching the different parts of your production line work together, moving one piece after another through the level.

💥 CRUSH ORE INTO VALUABLE METAL

Deliver raw ore to the crusher and watch it break into processed metal. Turn a growing stream of rocks into a satisfying flow of valuable materials, ready for your robots to collect.

🤖 COLLECT, DELIVER AND EARN

Your robots handle the next step! Watch them pick up the finished metal and carry it to the bank. Every delivery earns money that you can put straight back into your production line.

📈 UPGRADE YOUR ENTIRE OPERATION

Spend your earnings on improvements throughout the level. Upgrade your ore supply, transport mechanisms, crusher and robots to keep materials moving and make your operation more productive.

🌎 PROGRESS THROUGH DIFFERENT LEVELS

Move on to new levels with different layouts and watch your production take shape. Keep upgrading as you discover the next setup of machines and ore-processing action.

🎮 GAME FEATURES:

• Tap to drop raw ore onto the level
• Move materials with pistons, spinning mechanisms and conveyors
• Crush ore and extract valuable metal
• Watch robots collect and deliver your finished materials
• Earn money and upgrade every part of your production line
• Progress through levels with different layouts
• Enjoy relaxing idle gameplay and satisfying machine action

From the first falling rock to the final robot delivery, every step brings you closer to a bigger and better operation. Keep tapping, keep crushing and keep upgrading!

Start your production line in Ore Mining & Refining!

The tile-matching wake-up step is short, clear, and easy to follow. It adds a little visual focus at the moment the alarm matters, without turning the process into something stressful or hard to use.

What you can do in the app
- Set alarms for daily routines, reminders, and important times
- Use one-time alarms or repeated schedules
- Choose ringtone and vibration settings
- Stop alarms right away or with a short mahjong match
- Manage multiple alarms from one place
- Open additional mahjong play outside the alarm flow
Tea Garden Mahjong Alarm is for people who want an alarm app that does more than ring and disappear, while still staying simple to use every day.
